d:
The Timberwolves defeated the Bucks, 112-100 tonight in Minnesota. LaMelo Ball finished with a team-high 34 points along with 6 rebounds and 6 three pointers for the Timberwolves, while Ayo Dosunmu tallied 19 points, 12 rebounds and 8 assists in the game. Tyler Herro recorded 21 points, 6 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Timberwolves improve their record to 5-3 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-6 for the season.
